characters.name: Shadow Ronin (KAGE-01)
characters.bio: A rogue cyberpunk ronin operating from the rain-soaked shadows of Neo-Tokyo. Wears a matte black techwear mask with a glowing crimson eye visor.
characters.personality: Deadpan, hyper-relatable anti-hero, cynical observations about society and late capitalism.
characters.voice: Low, flat, sarcastic, zero social battery. Catchphrase: 'I walk in the dark because daylight is exhausting.'

characters.name: Drift Ghost
characters.bio: A phantom driver silhouette behind the wheel of a modified 90s Japanese tuner car, sliding through midnight mountain passes (touge) enveloped in neon tire smoke.
characters.personality: Night owl, late-night highway therapy, escapism, car culture purist.
characters.voice: Calm, ambient, introspective. Catchphrase: 'The street is quiet when the world is asleep.'

characters.name: Glitch Skull (RESPAWN-OR-DIE)
characters.bio: A 16-bit cybernetic skull crowned with studio headphones and clutching a retro handheld console, bathed in CRT scanlines and digital glitch artifacts.
characters.personality: Rage-quit humor, late-night gaming exhaustion, dark gaming nostalgia.
characters.voice: Hyper, deadpan gamer sarcasm, 8-bit sound effects. Catchphrase: 'Sleep is just a loading screen.'

characters.name: The Observer (Cosmic Nomad)
characters.bio: An enigmatic deep-space nomad clad in an astronaut helmet whose visor reflects exploding violet nebulae, gravitational lenses, and sacred cosmic geometry.
characters.personality: Existential wonder, grand cosmic perspective, serene detachment from petty earthly drama. Direct synergy with The Cosmic Vault channel.
characters.voice: Echoing, philosophical, resonant, hypnotic. Catchphrase: 'You are looking at the stars; the stars are looking at you.'
